sources.title: D delegates and scoped versus escaping closure environments
sources.version_or_date: Live specification; original publication/version date unknown
sources.sections_read: Nested functions; method attributes; function pointers, delegates and closures; no-GC closure restriction.
sources.confirmed: Nested functions can read and write enclosing variables; delegate values carry context and function pointers. Captured variables can outlive the creating call through GC allocation, while scope uses avoid that allocation.
sources.limits: The documented escape mechanism uses GC and does not directly supply ownership transfer or consuming-call semantics. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C21.json.

sources.title: Nim closure procedure representation and inline versus closure iterators
sources.sections_read: Procedure calling conventions, closures, and first-class iterators.
sources.confirmed: Closure procedure values hold a procedure pointer and environment pointer; captures are shared by reference and can use stack or heap environments. Explicit inline and closure iterator forms expose an optimization/first-class-value tradeoff.
sources.limits: Captures are by reference; iterator distinctions do not directly define consuming/read-only/mutable invocation capabilities. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C21.json.

sources.title: ATS environment-free, ordinary and linear closure types
sources.sections_read: Full chapter on linear closure types, preserved arguments and explicit freeing.
sources.confirmed: ATS linear closure types track resources and support explicit freeing; a nonconsuming parameter annotation preserves the closure after an operation, allowing repeat use followed by destruction.
sources.limits: Linear ownership is not automatically consuming invocation; the examples require ATS-specific types and explicit resource handling. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C21.json.

sources.title: C++ closure classes with independent capture and invocation mutability
sources.sections_read: Title/date and pages 1-7: closure representation, inline call operator, mutable qualifier, copy/reference capture, move construction and lifetime caveat.
sources.confirmed: Dated wording defines a unique closure class, inline call operator with const controlled by mutable, separate copy and reference capture, and warns about references outliving their referents.
sources.limits: Reference capture can dangle; consuming invocation is not established, and inline does not guarantee inlining. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C21.json.
